CustomField.description: Number of reasoning tokens the AI may spend before choosing a label. 1024 (the default) suits the models that keep reasoning whatever they are told, which return nothing at all without room for it. 0 turns reasoning off, which is faster and cheaper on models where that works. Only Gemini models that support thinking use this value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of reasoning tokens the AI may spend before choosing a label. 1024 is the default. 0 turns reasoning off, which some models answer with nothing at all. Only Gemini models that support thinking use this value.
CustomField.label: AI Labeling Thinking Budget
